info.title: Junction Client API
info.description:
This API follows the [JSON:API][jsonapi] specification.

A suggested booking flow example:

1. Retrieve Places from `GET /places`.
2. Initiate a Trip Search with `POST /trips/searches` by specifying one Place as origin and another as destination. This will start an asynchronous process to find suitable trips.
3. Retrieve Trip results from `GET /trips/searches/{tripSearchId}/trips`.
4. Intiate an Offer Search with `POST /offers/searches` by specifying one or more Trips. This will start an asynchronous process to find suitable trips.
5. Retrieve Offer results from `GET /offers/searches/{offerSearchId}/offers`.
6. Create an Order with `POST /orders` by specifyng one or more Offers.

[jsonapi]: https://jsonapi.org/

get.description:
The List places endpoint is used to find the origin and destination locations for the Trip Search endpoint.

A place is an indexed reference to a location that Junction might have related content for. It is specified in a trip search to state where a passenger wishes to travel from/to. Each place is allocated a unique identifier.
A place can be a Rail station or an Airport.

The List places endpoint purposefully doesn't support filtering and sorting. The API client should fetch the places once, and store them on their side, so that multiple calls to this endpoint are avoided.

A place is an indexed reference to a location that Junction might have related content for. It is specified in a trip search to state where a passenger wishes to travel from/to. Each place is allocated a unique identifier.

Places are curated by feeds from GTFS sources.  A place can be a rail station, Airport...
